verses.original: מִ֭שְׁלֵי שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בֶן־ דָּוִ֑ד מֶ֝֗לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: miš·lê šə·lō·mōh ḇen- dā·wiḏ me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: [These are] the proverbs of Solomon son of David king of Israel

verses.original: לָדַ֣עַת חָכְמָ֣ה וּמוּסָ֑ר לְ֝הָבִ֗ין אִמְרֵ֥י בִינָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḏa·‘aṯ ḥāḵ·māh ū·mū·sār lə·hā·ḇîn ’im·rê ḇî·nāh
verses.literal: for gaining wisdom and discipline for comprehending words of insight

verses.original: לָ֭קַחַת מוּסַ֣ר הַשְׂכֵּ֑ל צֶ֥דֶק וּ֝מִשְׁפָּ֗ט וּמֵישָׁרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: lā·qa·ḥaṯ mū·sar haś·kêl ṣe·ḏeq ū·miš·pāṭ ū·mê·šā·rîm
verses.literal: [and] for receiving instruction in wise living and in righteousness justice and equity

verses.original: לָתֵ֣ת עָרְמָ֑ה לִפְתָאיִ֣ם דַּ֣עַת וּמְזִמָּֽה׃ לְ֝נַ֗עַר
verses.transliteration: lā·ṯêṯ ‘ā·rə·māh lip̄·ṯā·yim da·‘aṯ ū·mə·zim·māh lə·na·‘ar
verses.literal: To impart prudence to the simple [and] knowledge and discretion to the young

verses.original: חָ֭כָם יִשְׁמַ֣ע וְי֣וֹסֶף לֶ֑קַח וְ֝נָב֗וֹן יִקְנֶֽה׃ תַּחְבֻּל֥וֹת
verses.transliteration: ḥā·ḵām yiš·ma‘ wə·yō·w·sep̄ le·qaḥ wə·nā·ḇō·wn yiq·neh taḥ·bu·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: {let} the wise listen and gain instruction and the discerning acquire wise counsel

verses.original: לְהָבִ֣ין מָ֭שָׁל וּמְלִיצָ֑ה דִּבְרֵ֥י וְחִידֹתָֽם׃ חֲ֝כָמִ֗ים
verses.transliteration: lə·hā·ḇîn mā·šāl ū·mə·lî·ṣāh diḇ·rê wə·ḥî·ḏō·ṯām ḥă·ḵā·mîm
verses.literal: by understanding the proverbs and parables the sayings and riddles of the wise

verses.original: יִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה רֵאשִׁ֣ית דָּ֑עַת אֱוִילִ֥ים בָּֽזוּ׃פ חָכְמָ֥ה וּ֝מוּסָ֗ר
verses.transliteration: yir·’aṯ Yah·weh rê·šîṯ dā·‘aṯ ’ĕ·wî·lîm bā·zū ḥāḵ·māh ū·mū·sār
verses.literal: The fear of the LORD [is] the beginning of knowledge [but] fools despise wisdom and discipline

verses.original: שְׁמַ֣ע בְּ֭נִי אָבִ֑יךָ מוּסַ֣ר תִּ֝טֹּ֗שׁ וְאַל־ תּוֹרַ֥ת אִמֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: šə·ma‘ bə·nî ’ā·ḇî·ḵā mū·sar tiṭ·ṭōš wə·’al- tō·w·raṯ ’im·me·ḵā
verses.literal: Listen my son to your father’s instruction and do not forsake . . . the teaching of your mother

verses.original: כִּ֤י׀ הֵ֬ם לִוְיַ֤ת חֵ֓ן לְרֹאשֶׁ֑ךָ וַ֝עֲנָקִ֗ים לְגַרְגְּרֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî hêm liw·yaṯ ḥên lə·rō·še·ḵā wa·‘ă·nā·qîm lə·ḡar·gə·rō·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: For they [are] a garland of grace on your head and a pendant around your neck

verses.original: בְּנִ֡י אִם־ חַ֝טָּאִ֗ים יְפַתּ֥וּךָ אַל־ תֹּבֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nî ’im- ḥaṭ·ṭā·’îm yə·p̄at·tū·ḵā ’al- tō·ḇê
verses.literal: My son if sinners entice you do not yield [to them]

verses.original: אִם־ יֹאמְרוּ֮ לְכָ֪ה אִ֫תָּ֥נוּ נֶאֶרְבָ֥ה לְדָ֑ם נִצְפְּנָ֖ה לְנָקִ֣י חִנָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- yō·mə·rū lə·ḵāh ’it·tā·nū ne·’er·ḇāh lə·ḏām niṣ·pə·nāh lə·nā·qî ḥin·nām
verses.literal: If they say Come along let us lie in wait for blood let us ambush the innocent without cause

verses.original: נִ֭בְלָעֵם חַיִּ֑ים כִּשְׁא֣וֹל וּ֝תְמִימִ֗ים כְּי֣וֹרְדֵי בֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: niḇ·lā·‘êm ḥay·yîm kiš·’ō·wl ū·ṯə·mî·mîm kə·yō·wr·ḏê ḇō·wr
verses.literal: let us swallow them alive like Sheol and whole like those descending into the Pit

verses.original: נִמְצָ֑א כָּל־ יָקָ֣ר ה֣וֹן נְמַלֵּ֖א בָתֵּ֣ינוּ שָׁלָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: nim·ṣā kāl- yā·qār hō·wn nə·mal·lê ḇāt·tê·nū šā·lāl
verses.literal: We {will} find all manner of precious goods we {will} fill our houses with plunder

verses.original: תַּפִּ֣יל גּ֭וֹרָ֣לְךָ בְּתוֹכֵ֑נוּ לְכֻלָּֽנוּ׃ יִהְיֶ֥ה אֶ֝חָ֗ד כִּ֥יס
verses.transliteration: tap·pîl gō·w·rā·lə·ḵā bə·ṯō·w·ḵê·nū lə·ḵul·lā·nū yih·yeh ’e·ḥāḏ kîs
verses.literal: Throw in your lot with us let us all share one purse

verses.original: בְּנִ֗י אַל־ תֵּלֵ֣ךְ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ אִתָּ֑ם מְנַ֥ע רַ֝גְלְךָ֗ מִנְּתִיבָתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nî ’al- tê·lêḵ bə·ḏe·reḵ ’it·tām mə·na‘ raḡ·lə·ḵā min·nə·ṯî·ḇā·ṯām
verses.literal: my son do not walk the road with them or set foot upon their path

verses.original: כִּ֣י רַ֭גְלֵיהֶם יָר֑וּצוּ לָרַ֣ע וִֽ֝ימַהֲר֗וּ לִשְׁפָּךְ־ דָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî raḡ·lê·hem yā·rū·ṣū lā·ra‘ wî·ma·hă·rū liš·pāḵ- dām
verses.literal: For their feet run to evil and they are swift to shed blood

verses.original: כִּֽי־ חִ֭נָּם מְזֹרָ֣ה הָרָ֑שֶׁת כָל־ בַּ֥עַל כָּנָֽף׃ בְּ֝עֵינֵ֗י
verses.transliteration: kî- ḥin·nām mə·zō·rāh hā·rā·šeṯ ḵāl ba·ʿal kā·nāp̄ bə·‘ê·nê
verses.literal: How futile [it is] to spread the net where any bird . . . can see it

verses.original: וְ֭הֵם יֶאֱרֹ֑בוּ לְדָמָ֣ם יִ֝צְפְּנ֗וּ לְנַפְשֹׁתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hêm ye·’ĕ·rō·ḇū lə·ḏā·mām yiṣ·pə·nū lə·nap̄·šō·ṯām
verses.literal: But they lie in wait for their [own] blood they ambush their [own] lives

verses.original: כֵּ֗ן אָ֭רְחוֹת כָּל־ בֹּ֣צֵֽעַ בָּ֑צַע אֶת־ יִקָּֽח׃פ נֶ֖פֶשׁ בְּעָלָ֣יו
verses.transliteration: kên ’ā·rə·ḥō·wṯ kāl- bō·ṣê·a‘ bā·ṣa‘ ’eṯ- yiq·qāḥ ne·p̄eš bə·‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: Such [is] the fate of all who are greedy whose unjust gain - takes the lives of its possessors

verses.original: חָ֭כְמוֹת תָּרֹ֑נָּה בַּח֣וּץ תִּתֵּ֥ן קוֹלָֽהּ׃ בָּ֝רְחֹב֗וֹת
verses.transliteration: ḥā·ḵə·mō·wṯ tā·rōn·nāh ba·ḥūṣ tit·tên qō·w·lāh bā·rə·ḥō·ḇō·wṯ
verses.literal: Wisdom calls out in the street she lifts her voice in the square

verses.original: בְּרֹ֥אשׁ הֹמִיּ֗וֹת תִּ֫קְרָ֥א בָּעִ֗יר בְּפִתְחֵ֖י שְׁעָרִ֥ים תֹאמֵֽר׃ אֲמָרֶ֥יהָ
verses.transliteration: bə·rōš hō·mî·yō·wṯ tiq·rā bā·‘îr bə·p̄iṯ·ḥê šə·‘ā·rîm ṯō·mêr ’ă·mā·re·hā
verses.literal: in the main concourse she cries aloud at the city vvv gates she makes her speech

verses.original: עַד־ מָתַ֣י׀ פְּתָיִם֮ תְּֽאֵהֲב֫וּ פֶ֥תִי וְלֵצִ֗ים חָמְד֣וּ לָהֶ֑ם לָ֭צוֹן וּ֝כְסִילִ֗ים יִשְׂנְאוּ־ דָֽעַת׃
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ- mā·ṯay pə·ṯā·yim tə·’ê·hă·ḇū p̄e·ṯî wə·lê·ṣîm ḥā·mə·ḏū lā·hem lā·ṣō·wn ū·ḵə·sî·lîm yiś·nə·’ū- ḏā·‘aṯ
verses.literal: How long O simple ones will you love your simple [ways] How long will scoffers delight . . . in their scorn and fools hate knowledge

verses.original: תָּשׁ֗וּבוּ לְֽת֫וֹכַחְתִּ֥י הִנֵּ֤ה אַבִּ֣יעָה לָכֶ֣ם רוּחִ֑י אוֹדִ֖יעָה דְבָרַ֣י אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: tā·šū·ḇū lə·ṯō·w·ḵaḥ·tî hin·nêh ’ab·bî·‘āh lā·ḵem rū·ḥî ’ō·w·ḏî·‘āh ḏə·ḇā·ray ’eṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: If you had repented at my rebuke then surely I would have poured out my spirit on you I would have made my words known to you

verses.original: יַ֣עַן וַתְּמָאֵ֑נוּ קָ֭רָאתִי וְאֵ֣ין מַקְשִֽׁיב׃ נָטִ֥יתִי יָ֝דִ֗י
verses.transliteration: ya·‘an wat·tə·mā·’ê·nū qā·rā·ṯî wə·’ên maq·šîḇ nā·ṭî·ṯî yā·ḏî
verses.literal: Because you refused my call and no one took my outstretched hand

verses.original: וַתִּפְרְע֥וּ כָל־ עֲצָתִ֑י אֲבִיתֶֽם׃ לֹ֣א וְ֝תוֹכַחְתִּ֗י
verses.transliteration: wat·tip̄·rə·‘ū ḵāl ‘ă·ṣā·ṯî ’ă·ḇî·ṯem lō wə·ṯō·w·ḵaḥ·tî
verses.literal: because you neglected all my counsel and wanted none of my correction

verses.original: גַּם־ אֲ֭נִי אֶשְׂחָ֑ק בְּאֵידְכֶ֣ם אֶ֝לְעַ֗ג פַחְדְּכֶֽם׃ בְּבֹ֣א
verses.transliteration: gam- ’ă·nî ’eś·ḥāq bə·’ê·ḏə·ḵem ’el·‘aḡ p̄aḥ·də·ḵem bə·ḇō
verses.literal: in turn I will mock your calamity I will sneer when terror strikes you

verses.original: פַּחְדְּכֶ֗ם בְּבֹ֤א כְשַׁאֲוָה וְֽ֭אֵידְכֶם יֶאֱתֶ֑ה כְּסוּפָ֣ה צָרָ֥ה וְצוּקָֽה׃ בְּבֹ֥א עֲ֝לֵיכֶ֗ם
verses.transliteration: paḥ·də·ḵem bə·ḇō ḵə·ša·ʾă·wå̄h wə·’ê·ḏə·ḵem ye·’ĕ·ṯeh kə·sū·p̄āh ṣā·rāh wə·ṣū·qāh bə·ḇō ‘ă·lê·ḵem
verses.literal: when your dread comes like a storm and your destruction - like a whirlwind when distress and anguish overwhelm you . . .

verses.original: אָ֣ז יִ֭קְרָאֻנְנִי וְלֹ֣א אֶֽעֱנֶ֑ה יְ֝שַׁחֲרֻ֗נְנִי וְלֹ֣א יִמְצָאֻֽנְנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ’āz yiq·rā·’un·nî wə·lō ’e·‘ĕ·neh yə·ša·ḥă·run·nî wə·lō yim·ṣā·’un·nî
verses.literal: Then they will call on me but I will not answer they {will} earnestly seek me but {will} not find me

verses.original: תַּ֭חַת כִּי־ שָׂ֣נְאוּ דָ֑עַת בָחָֽרוּ׃ לֹ֣א וְיִרְאַ֥ת יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה
verses.transliteration: ta·ḥaṯ kî- śā·nə·’ū ḏā·‘aṯ ḇā·ḥā·rū lō wə·yir·’aṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: vvv For they hated knowledge and chose not to fear the LORD

verses.original: אָב֥וּ לֹא־ לַעֲצָתִ֑י נָ֝אֲצ֗וּ כָּל־ תּוֹכַחְתִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḇū lō- la·‘ă·ṣā·ṯî nā·’ă·ṣū kāl- tō·w·ḵaḥ·tî
verses.literal: They accepted none of my counsel they despised all my reproof

verses.original: וְֽ֭יֹאכְלוּ מִפְּרִ֣י דַרְכָּ֑ם יִשְׂבָּֽעוּ׃ וּֽמִמֹּעֲצֹ֖תֵיהֶ֣ם
verses.transliteration: wə·yō·ḵə·lū mip·pə·rî ḏar·kām yiś·bā·‘ū ū·mim·mō·‘ă·ṣō·ṯê·hem
verses.literal: So they {will} eat the fruit of their own way and be filled with their own devices

verses.original: כִּ֤י מְשׁוּבַ֣ת פְּתָיִ֣ם תַּֽהַרְגֵ֑ם וְשַׁלְוַ֖ת כְּסִילִ֣ים תְּאַבְּדֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî mə·šū·ḇaṯ pə·ṯā·yim ta·har·ḡêm wə·šal·waṯ kə·sî·lîm tə·’ab·bə·ḏêm
verses.literal: For the waywardness of the simple will slay them and the complacency of fools will destroy them

verses.original: וְשֹׁמֵ֣עַֽ לִ֭י יִשְׁכָּן־ בֶּ֑טַח וְ֝שַׁאֲנַ֗ן מִפַּ֥חַד רָעָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·šō·mê·a‘ lî yiš·kān- be·ṭaḥ wə·ša·’ă·nan mip·pa·ḥaḏ rā·‘āh
verses.literal: But whoever listens to me {will} dwell in safety secure from the fear of evil
